summary: Sportradar Group AG filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on October 6, 2026, its subsidiary Sportradar AG entered into a purchase and sale agreement with Teamworks Innovations, Inc. to divest 100% of Atrium Sports Inc., operator of the Synergy Sports coaching and scouting business, for a cash purchase price of $170 million subject to customary adjustments. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026, pending customary closing conditions. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, covenants and indemnification provisions. The filing incorporates the report by reference into existing registration statements. Watch integration and regulatory closing risk and any purchase price adjustments affecting net proceeds.
